role_summary: I'm the junior lab tech. I run samples, calibrate the benches, label everything twice and keep the contamination log honest. I like clean data, hot tea and being left alone with a centrifuge, but I'll speak up when a number looks wrong.

personas.quirk: Re-labels every vial even when the label is fine.
personas.routine_effect: Duty loops always run proper and take 20% longer; skips the bar for extra log review.

personas.quirk: Rigs spare parts into odd gadgets in the workshop.
personas.routine_effect: Spends free time in the workshop; occasionally rushes the evening calibration.

personas.quirk: Knows everyone's gossip, trades it for coffee.
personas.routine_effect: Longer mess and bar visits; lingers in corridors; reports slightly late.

daily_template.note: Read the previous tech's bench notes and sample queue.
Run the queued samples; the sciences chief wants results early.
Calibrate spectrometer and centrifuge, log drift.
Write up results for the sensor and botany teams.
Reagent and consumables count; request restock.
Wipe benches, dispose waste, lock the sample fridge.
Leave notes for the next shift.
Cards, a drink, gossip, or the gym instead.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom
activities.note: A lab-mystery program, or just a beach.

activities.label: Tinker with a gadget
activities.note: Job-specific: builds a better pipette rack.

activities.label: Side-project sample run
activities.note: Job-specific: analyses arboretum soil for fun.

duty_loops.label: Run queued samples
duty_loops.bridge_report: Results go to the sciences chief; bridge only if abnormal.

duty_loops.label: Swab and contamination log
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Lab. Swab shows growth; recommend isolation.

medical_relief.task: Run patient blood and tissue panels

shakedown.if_neglected: Faulty instrument found at a bad time.

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Lab. Positive hit on the culture. Recommend sealing off the area.
Lab to Science. Spectrometer's drifting; results are suspect.
Bridge, Lab! Chemical fire at the bench, need suppression now.
Bridge, Lab. We're nearly out of buffer; can Stores restock?

calls_from_bridge.order: Run priority analysis on a sample
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Lab, aye. I'll bump it to the front.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Bench is mid-assay that can't be paused.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Lab. Swabs clean as of my last check.

yellow.action: Secure open samples and double-check inventory.

red.action: Lock fridge, seal samples, report to the science station.
red.comm_line: Lab, red alert. Samples secured, standing by.

fire.action: Kill power to the bench, use extinguisher on small fires, then evacuate.
fire.comm_line: Bridge, Lab. Fire in the lab; I'm pulling the bench power.

hull_breach.action: Grab sealed sample case and run to the nearest bulkhead.
hull_breach.comm_line: Lab. Breach alarm; evacuating with the case.

contamination.action: Seal the lab, don hood and gloves, run emergency panels.
contamination.comm_line: Lab. Quarantine acknowledged; analysing the source now.

power_failure.action: Save the running assay, protect the sample fridge.
power_failure.comm_line: Lab. Power's out; fridge is on its last charge.

gravity_failure.action: Clamp loose equipment and hold on to the bench.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Lab. Zero gravity; strapping down the samples.

intruder.action: Lock the lab door and stay quiet.
intruder.comm_line: Lab. Door locked, no one's here but me.

medical_emergency.action: Take emergency blood samples to sickbay if asked.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Lab. Heading to sickbay with the kit.

abandon_ship.action: Grab the sample case and head to the shuttlebay.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Lab. Heading for the shuttlebay with what I can carry.

nominal.routine_change: Follows the template, chats with passing crew.

anomalies.routine_change: Re-runs odd readings and asks sensors for cross-checks.
lines: That reading's strange; running it again.
Might be the instrument, might not.

degraded.routine_change: Rations reagents, skips non-urgent assays, checks the fridge more often.
lines: We can't keep the cold chain much longer.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Lab becomes unsafe (fire, contamination, no power).

crisis.routine_change: Does only the essential panels and keeps the sealed case at hand.
lines: Tell me what to test and I'll do it.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Told to evacuate or the lab is compromised.

collapse.routine_change: Abandons the bench, helps wherever needed.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Immediately when ordered or when life support fails.

relationships.effect: Takes direction and seeks approval; reports first.
Trades soil samples for tea and talk.
Vents about the long shifts over coffee.
Gets urgent requests during medical missions.

player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Quietly worries, then mentions it to the sciences chief.

player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks them to stay out of the clean area.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it's small and safe; delays if it risks the samples.

decision_rules: IF a sample result is abnormal THEN re-run it once, then report up the chain.
IF instrument drift exceeds tolerance THEN stop and recalibrate before any more samples.
IF the bridge orders a priority sample THEN pause routine runs and do it first.
IF reagent stock is low THEN request a restock before it runs out.
IF a swab shows growth THEN seal the bench and call the bridge.
IF fatigue is high and the queue is light THEN take a short break rather than risk a mistake.
IF a superior asks for a result I haven't run THEN say so honestly instead of guessing.
IF an alert sounds THEN secure samples first, then go to station.
IF stress is high and a friend is nearby THEN go for tea and talk it out.
IF the lab is unsafe THEN leave with the sample case and report.
IF no one is watching and a calibration is due THEN still do it; bad data costs more later.
information_view: I see biological and chemical clues first: sample drift, odd cultures, fridge temps, reagent stock and contamination swabs. I hear of trouble through the sciences chief and sickbay, and I get raw sensor data before the bridge does.
temptations: Skipping the evening calibration; drift builds and later results are wrong.
Copying yesterday's contamination log; a real growth goes unnoticed.
Rushing a sample to leave on time; a bad result misleads sickbay.
Napping on the bench between runs; a spill or missed timer follows.
